stemMd: Why were contrasting accounts shown beside photographs and plans?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To conceal the existence of disagreements.

options.label: B
options.textMd: To replace all interpretation with a numerical score.

options.label: C
options.textMd: To show the square had never changed.

options.label: D
options.textMd: To prove that one narrator must win a competition.

options.label: E
options.textMd: To help viewers examine different experiences in relation to other evidence.

explanationMd: Juxtaposing accounts with visual and spatial evidence invites contextual comparison. It makes unequal and changing experiences visible rather than suppressing them. The exhibition is not a contest to eliminate every disagreement.

distractorRationale.d: The project does not aim to select a single winning account.
distractorRationale.c: Changing meanings and periods are central to the passage.
